executive_messages: Evaluation window: Previous calendar month (2026-10) (2026-10-01T00:00:00Z → 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z) over 16 inventoried resources (10 need operational attention).
Consolidated incidents: 12 recorded (9 Azure Monitor native alerts and 3 official Azure Service Health communications).
Technical anomalies detected: 13 in total (3 VM/Arc extension failures, 5 connectivity/control plane anomalies, and 5 telemetry statistical/threshold anomalies).
Recommended action plan: 27 prioritized actions (3 Immediate <24h, 21 Short term 1-7 days, and 3 Monthly cycle), correlated with 3 Azure Advisor recommendations.
Source coverage: 5 of 6 evidence streams completed in read-only mode, without changing resources or agents.

limitations: Native alerts and Service Health events reflect the state and timestamps that Azure Monitor and Resource Health recorded at query time.
Extension and Azure Arc agent state in Azure Resource Graph is a control plane observation; the tool doesn't read protected settings or run commands inside the guest operating system.
Telemetry anomalies are calculated over the approved Log Analytics workspaces, for the resources that emit InsightsMetrics, Perf, or Heartbeat data in the window.
Recommended actions are prioritized operational guidance for human review; the agent operates strictly in read-only mode.
